name: ds12
long_name: Dimension subgroups: the 2-group search of order 2^12
description: Walks the subtree of a range of groups of order 512 from the SmallGroups library with GAP and ANUPQ and lists the candidate groups of order 2^12 it finds (Kourovka Notebook problem 20.84, the fifth dimension subgroup). Code: https://github.com/ispacex/dimension-subrings (boinc/README.md, section 2^12).
